text: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender (2026 Movie) brings back peak childhood nostalgia, proving it's still the GOAT cartoon—though it's a bummer they didn't bring back the original voice cast.

The Pyramid Scheme (2026 TV Series) is a missed opportunity that only redeems itself in its final episode. Missed opportunity; could have been way better - failing to deliver a compelling look at how high/mid-level scams actually operate, and what was particularly disappointing was that the series failed to share the awareness and the dangers of how pyramid schemes continue to attract people. Scams succeed by selling status, confidence, and belonging rather than actual products, masking exploitation as a positive lifestyle change and targeting the psychological vulnerabilities that allow blind faith in quick wealth to flourish.
